comments.body:
Future content. Obtained as a lotto random drop item, but who knows what the case will be on Maris. Stats:

Textile Trading +3
Sewing +2
Storage +2
EX Effect Increase sailing speed R6

Notes: It equips in the Weapon slot but does not count as an actual weapon. It also has no item effect to prevent durability loss, which is a shame. It's very snuggly though. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you and your plush pinniped pals.
